# Best noise-cancelling earbuds under $150

I can't open product pages here, so the links below go to the articles where I found each pick, and those articles have the retailer buy buttons. The one exception is the Liberty 4 Pro, which has a direct store link.

## Top picks

**1. Nothing Ear (3): best ANC under $150**
- Prices run just under $150 on Amazon ([SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)).
- SoundGuys scored its noise cancelling 8.2/10, and it has LDAC, multipoint and wireless charging ([iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/)).
- Downsides are bass-heavy tuning, muffled call mics, and about 5 hours of battery per charge with ANC on.

**2. Soundcore Liberty 4 Pro: best value**
- List price is $149.99. Dealectric tested code AFSC20 at Soundcore's US store and got $29.99 off, for about $120. It's valid through 2026-12-31 on full-price items. [Buy at Soundcore via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-liberty-4-pro). This is an affiliate link, and the store's checkout price is the final word.
- It has adaptive ANC, LDAC, multipoint and a wireless-charging case. Dealectric notes it has been superseded by the Liberty 5 Pro ([details](https://dealectric.com/soundcore-liberty-4-pro)).

**3. Samsung Galaxy Buds3 Pro: best for Android and Samsung phones**
- SlashGear found a new pair from Samsung's Amazon store for $134. It cites great adaptive ANC, IPX7 and up to 18 hours of battery with the case ([SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)).

**4. AirPods Pro 2: best for iPhone**
- Apple no longer sells them new, but SlashGear says renewed pairs go for just under $150 on sale, with ANC it calls "in a class of its own." Check the seller and warranty ([SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)).

## Cheaper options
- **Sony WF-C710N (~$119–128):** Sony's reliable ANC and app, but no LDAC. What Hi-Fi? lists it at Walmart, Sweetwater and Best Buy ([What Hi-Fi?](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-the-true-wireless-way-to-cut-out-background-noise)).
- **Soundcore P31i ($59.99):** solid adaptive ANC for the price, with about 8 hours per charge ([SlashGear](https://www.slashgear.com/2266118/best-noise-cancelling-earbuds-can-buy-affordable-2026/)).
- **Google Pixel Buds 2a ($129):** a good Android choice with ANC and up to 7 hours of battery ([iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/)).
- **Soundcore Space A40:** RTINGS' budget pick, with ANC that matches many top earbuds. Its call mic is poor, and I don't have a current price ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/noise-cancelling-earbuds)).

## Which to choose
- **Strongest ANC:** Nothing Ear (3), or the Galaxy Buds3 Pro if you're on Samsung.
- **iPhone:** AirPods Pro 2 (renewed). The new AirPods 5 ($129–$149) are open-fit, so they block less noise ([iTech Level](https://itechlevel.com/best-wireless-earbuds-under-150-2026/)).
- **Lowest price:** Soundcore P31i or Sony WF-C710N.

Prices change often, so confirm the current price before you buy.
